title: The Easiest Way to Start Learning French — Watch This First
description:
In this short preview, you'll see the very start of Session 1 from our new beginner course, Ease Into French with 5 Stories.

Before I ever say a French word out loud, I show it to you — a gesture, a small action, something your body can understand before your brain translates it. 

Here, you'll see how I teach the verb soupire (to sigh) — no textbook, no translation, just watching and letting the meaning arrive.

This is the opening moment of Ketchup, the first of five real, funny stories by Bernard Friot that make up the full course.

This course is perfect for true beginners, seniors returning to French, homeschool families, and French teachers looking for a ready-made lesson.

⭐ Get the full course (5 stories, videos, synced audio & text, transcripts, comprehension questions — yours for life): https://www.aliceayel.com/boutique/

⭐ Story Listening the natural way — no grammar drills, ever

If this is your first time here, welcome! I'm Alice, and this is the home for anyone learning French the natural way, one story at a time.
